scope: Real fs.read / test.run / file repair with optional Native tool-window preparation; deterministic action selection

method.calibration: Actual tools and actual preparation: each policy starts from the same per-operation median of3 calibration labels; then only its own past evaluation labels update EWMA
method.order: Within each case:7 modes, order rotates by replicate; model already resident; initial history computed before task, excluded and recorded
method.execution: Real capability functions, deployed C compiler + test process. compile_test observes FAIL, writes full correction, observes PASS twice; read invokes real workspace file reads
method.oracle: 12 independent full-upstream-render/tokenize/fresh-KV greedy references, one per case/step; every measurement checks exact IDs/greedy. Validation after first-token timestamp; first two validation costs subtracted from task wall
method.timing: Tool entry includes checkpoint/save/eviction; after-tool includes final rendering/tokenization/suffix prefill/greedy. File repair and intermediate model preparation included in task time
method.scope: Same host module is opt-in in agentctl-native test.run. Timing actions scripted, not autonomous-model success; normal resident KV baseline retained
method.cache: Warm process/device/OS-file-cache. Same live session and revision only; saves are charged, physical KV buffer allocation unchanged

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B backend; no cold SSD/Windows/CUDA/PCIe claims
Explicit recompute/restore policy creates nonresident KV, not an assumption about all ordinary local-agent calls
One tool + one preparation, no foreground multi-consumer preemption, cold-engine startup or live cloud source
Prefix bookkeeping borrows canonical tokens; complete rendering/guard and suffix work still happen after the actual receipt
Small controlled sample and CPU/compiler noise; all paired signs/ranges retained, no p95/p99 or Gaussian readiness guarantee

native_sanitizers.scope: Full legacy Native/14K/KV/Stream passed; final tool cancellation cutoff and collector + actual scripted CLI checked separately under ASan/UBSan

cli_integration.scope: Native CLI registration/store/worker/tool path with deterministic Native-parser actions

model_cli_probe.scope: Native CLI registration/worker/tool path; single model smoke probe, not autonomous capability benchmark
model_cli_probe.failure_reason: Bare tool JSON was emitted as prose without tool_call envelope; zero actual tool executions
